statement:
∀ (b : ℤ),
  Odd b →
    (Function.Injective fun k => 2 * k + b) ∧
      (¬Function.Surjective fun k => 2 * k + b) ∧ (Set.range fun k => 2 * k + b) = {n | Odd n}
script:
# name: set-int-affine-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Bijective.int_affine
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by decide)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (b : ℤ) (hb : Odd b), Function.Injective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ ¬ Function.Surjective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ Set.range (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) = {n | Odd n} := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨fun x y h => by simpa using h, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h 0
    simp only at hk
    omega
  · ext n
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Odd]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k + c, by ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m - c, by ring⟩
exact @key (1) ((by decide))'),
    (['3', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (b : ℤ) (hb : Odd b), Function.Injective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ ¬ Function.Surjective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ Set.range (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) = {n | Odd n} := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨fun x y h => by simpa using h, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h 0
    simp only at hk
    omega
  · ext n
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Odd]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k + c, by ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m - c, by ring⟩
exact @key (3) ((by decide))'),
    (['-1', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (b : ℤ) (hb : Odd b), Function.Injective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ ¬ Function.Surjective (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) ∧ Set.range (fun k : ℤ => 2 * k + b) = {n | Odd n} := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨fun x y h => by simpa using h, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h 0
    simp only at hk
    omega
  · ext n
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Odd]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k + c, by ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m - c, by ring⟩
exact @key (-1) ((by decide))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
